title: Cam Workshop
subtitle: One turn, four phases, three ways to move.
description: A hands-on radial cam instrument: edit rise, dwell, and return timing, compare exact harmonic, cycloidal, and 3–4–5 motion laws, and follow a knife edge along the real rotating profile.
instruction: Pause a turn, scrub the cam angle, and compare how each motion law changes the profile and its derivatives.
